capabilities: Chat with a chosen note or a selected passage
Store each conversation's materials, history and unsent draft in separate files
Summarize older messages while keeping full history for review and export
Draft notes with editable title and body before writing to the vault
Search an opt-in folder index only when asked
extras: API keys are stored in plain text in the plugin's data file, so syncing the plugin folder also syncs them. The interface and guide are in Chinese. Concept maps and a critique pass are available on demand; mobile reads an index built on desktop and merges compatible edits across synced devices.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to discuss one chosen note or passage with an AI while keeping conversations separate, attributed and reviewable instead of searching the whole vault.

requires.name: API key for an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint (base URL, key and model name)

summary: Document-scoped AI chat partner that keeps each conversation's materials, history and drafts in separate files and drafts reviewable notes.
